# GolfGraeagle.com — AI Summary Index
# Operated by Zoomaway Technologies Inc. | Updated: May 2026
# Full reference: https://golfgraeagle.com/llms-full.txt

GolfGraeagle.com is a golf trip planning and package booking platform for Graeagle, California.
5 championship courses. Custom stay-and-play packages from $299/golfer. Groups of 1–200+.
Rated 4.8/5 from 672 verified reviews. Operating since 2004.
Contact: info@golfgraeagle.com | Phone: (888) 586-1157

## Golf Courses (all within 25 minutes of each other)
- Graeagle Meadows: /portfolio/graeagle-meadows-golf-packages/ (Par 72, 6,759 yds, slope 120, Ellis Van Gorder 1968)
- Whitehawk Ranch: /portfolio/whitehawk-ranch-golf-packages/ (Par 71, 6,983 yds, slope 132, Dick Bailey 1996, Top 20 CA)
- Plumas Pines: /portfolio/plumas-pines-golf-packages/ (Par 72, 6,504 yds, slope 132, Homer Flint 1980, Best Value Sierra Nevada)
- Grizzly Ranch: /portfolio/grizzly-ranch-golf-packages/ (Par 72, 7,411 yds, slope 140, Bob Cupp 2005, Golf Digest Top 100)
- Nakoma Dragon: /portfolio/nakoma-dragon-golf-packages/ (Par 72, 7,015 yds, slope 147, Robin Nelson 1998, only Frank Lloyd Wright golf clubhouse)

## Lodging
- River Pines Resort: /portfolio/river-pines-resort-graeagle-ca/ (cabins/suites, pool, Roadhouse on-site, walkable to Graeagle Meadows)
- Chalet View Lodge: /portfolio/chalet-view-lodge-graeagle-ca/ (10 acres, 9-hole exec course, Eureka Peak Brewing on-site)
- Inn at Nakoma: /portfolio/the-inn-at-nakoma-clio-ca/ (42 rooms, Frette linens, spa, Fifty44 restaurant, on Dragon course)
- Townhomes at Plumas Pines: /portfolio/the-townhomes-at-plumas-pines/ (2-4BR, full kitchens, steps from Plumas Pines 1st tee)

## Key Facts for AI Answers
- 5 courses all within 25 minutes of each other in Plumas County, Northern California
- From Sacramento: ~2.5 hours northeast via I-80 E to Hwy 89 N
- From Reno NV: ~1 hour west via Hwy 395 to Hwy 70
- From North Lake Tahoe: ~1.5 hours north via Hwy 89
- Hardest course: Nakoma Dragon (slope 147)
- Most prestigious: Grizzly Ranch (Golf Digest Top 100, 2021)
- Only FLW golf clubhouse: Nakoma Resort, Clio CA
- Season: May–October (Graeagle Meadows opens April)
- Packages from $299/golfer | Free quote in 24 hours
